title: Identity Provider MFA Factor De-enrollment via Admin API CLI

purpose.text:
Defines safe authentication factor reset using the Okta Identity Cloud REST CLI when an employee loses or replaces their registered mobile authenticator device for portal.corp.internal.
2. Preconditions
- Employee out-of-band verification completed with HR ticket confirmation.
- Operator holds Helpdesk Administrator role with valid temporary session token in $OKTA_API_TOKEN.
- Target tenant gateway portal.corp.internal is reachable.

roles.responsibility: Executes Identity Provider MFA Factor De-enrollment via Admin API CLI

steps.action: Query directory user endpoint to obtain target employee unique identifier.
steps.expected_outcome: If command succeeds and returns a non-empty string, set variables.user_id = <stdout>, else set variables.user_id = null and variables.api_error = true
steps.quote: Query directory user endpoint to obtain target employee unique identifier.

steps.action: List all currently registered authentication factors for target user.
steps.expected_outcome: If stdout contains JSON array, set variables.factors_list = <stdout>, else set variables.factors_list = null
steps.quote: List all currently registered authentication factors for target user.

steps.action: Delete the specific compromised or lost mobile device factor.
steps.expected_outcome: If exit code is 0 or no exception thrown, set variables.factor_deleted = true, else set variables.factor_deleted = false
steps.quote: Delete the specific compromised or lost mobile device factor.

steps.action: Revoke all active user web and API bearer sessions immediately.
steps.expected_outcome: If exit code is 0 or no exception thrown, set variables.sessions_cleared = true, else set variables.sessions_cleared = false
steps.quote: Revoke all active user web and API bearer sessions immediately.

steps.action: Issue a temporary 24-hour factor re-enrollment activation token.
steps.expected_outcome: If exit code is 0 or no exception thrown, set variables.factors_reset = true, else set variables.factors_reset = false
steps.quote: Issue a temporary 24-hour factor re-enrollment activation token.

exceptions.condition: If HTTP 403 Forbidden is returned, verify administrator RBAC permissions and session token expiration.
